data.text:
Police heroic deeds saved a bicycle rider injured in an accident.

#MSNews | Three cops, namely Police Staff Sergeant Saul, Patrolman Luna, and Patrolman Geronimo, assisted a bicycle rider along Heritage Park service road on early Saturday morning (December 6) following a collision with a motorcycle.

The cyclist was transported by an ambulance and medical team from Barangay Pinagsama to the nearest hospital and is now recuperating from his injuries sustained from the accident. | via Vince Lopez

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
